es: Leer un comunicado entre dos asociaciones y traducir sus frases diplomáticas a lenguaje directo, repasando las preguntas reportadas.

vocabulary.es: un intercambio franco, una discusión dura
quedarse a las puertas de, no llegar a

teaching.en: When a statement says that the association will take note of your complaint, it may simply mean that it has heard you.
teaching.es: Cuando un comunicado dice que la asociación tomará nota de tu queja, puede significar simplemente que te ha escuchado.
teaching.explanationEs: Take note of = tomar nota: reconoce que recibió el mensaje, pero no promete actuar.
segments: When a statement says that the association will take note of
your complaint, it may simply mean that it has heard you.
teaching.audioText: When a statement says that the association will take note of your complaint, it may simply mean that it has heard you.

teaching.en: In a statement, a frank exchange of views is code for a disagreement that was heated, even if nobody shouted.
teaching.es: En un comunicado, un intercambio franco de opiniones es una forma cifrada de decir que hubo un desacuerdo acalorado, aunque nadie gritara.
teaching.explanationEs: Frank suena amable, pero suele esconder una discusión dura; code for = forma cifrada de decir.
segments: In a statement, a frank exchange of views is code
for a disagreement that was heated, even if nobody shouted.
teaching.audioText: In a statement, a frank exchange of views is code for a disagreement that was heated, even if nobody shouted.

teaching.en: We note with concern that the garden has still not been cleaned, which reads as a polite complaint.
teaching.es: Observamos con preocupación que el jardín sigue sin limpiarse, lo que se lee como una queja cortés.
teaching.explanationEs: We note with concern = estamos preocupados y queremos que cambie; la queja va envuelta en una fórmula neutra.
segments: We note with concern that the garden has still
not been cleaned, which reads as a polite complaint.
teaching.audioText: We note with concern that the garden has still not been cleaned, which reads as a polite complaint.

teaching.en: We regret that the meeting ended early, yet what is on the record is sorrow, not an admission of fault.
teaching.es: Lamentamos que la reunión terminara pronto, pero lo que consta oficialmente es pena, no una admisión de culpa.
teaching.explanationEs: Regret expresa pesar sin reconocer responsabilidad; on the record = lo que queda dicho oficialmente.
segments: We regret that the meeting ended early, yet what is
on the record is sorrow, not an admission of fault.
teaching.audioText: We regret that the meeting ended early, yet what is on the record is sorrow, not an admission of fault.

teaching.en: The association may remain committed to talks and still stop short of any concession, so read between the lines.
teaching.es: La asociación puede seguir comprometida con el diálogo y aun así no llegar a ninguna concesión, así que lee entre líneas.
teaching.explanationEs: Remain committed = seguir en la mesa; stop short of = no llegar a; read between the lines = leer lo no dicho.
segments: The association may remain committed to talks and still stop
short of any concession, so read between the lines.
teaching.audioText: The association may remain committed to talks and still stop short of any concession, so read between the lines.

teaching.en: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider its decision, which is a polite way of saying that it should.
teaching.es: El comité preguntó si la asociación reconsideraría su decisión, que es una forma cortés de decir que debería hacerlo.
teaching.explanationEs: En una pregunta reportada el orden es afirmativo (whether + sujeto + verbo); aquí la pregunta funciona como petición.
segments: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider its decision,
which is a polite way of saying that it should.
teaching.audioText: The committee asked whether the association would reconsider its decision, which is a polite way of saying that it should.

prompt.es: ¿Qué significa realmente «a frank exchange of views» en este comunicado?

choices.text: The two sides agreed on most points and spoke informally.
The two sides disagreed strongly and said so openly to each other.
The two sides avoided the subject and talked about other matters.

feedback.es: En lenguaje diplomático, franco suele esconder un desacuerdo abierto: hubo discusión, no acuerdo ni evasión.

hint.es: Frank suena amable, pero en un comunicado suele ser código de discusión dura.

origin.text: The Garden Association and the Youth Club issued a shared statement after Tuesday's meeting. It said that the two sides had held a frank exchange of views and that both remained committed to a solution.

prompt.es: Completa: «Observamos con preocupación que el jardín sigue sin limpiarse.»

feedback.es: We note with concern traduce una queja como preocupación oficial; regret o dismay serían variantes posibles.

hint.es: Sustantivo que significa «preocupación»; empieza por c.

origin.text: The letter said: «We note with ___ that the garden has still not been cleaned.» In plain terms, the writers are worried and want a change.

prompt.es: Ordena: «El club preguntó si reconsideraríamos la fecha.»

answer.text: The club asked whether we would reconsider the date

feedback.es: La pregunta reportada mantiene el orden afirmativo: whether + we + would reconsider.

hint.es: Empieza por The club asked whether y sigue sin inversión.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué se puede deducir del comunicado.

choices.text: That the dispute has ended and the timetable will now change for good.
That the dispute continues, although both sides want to keep talking.
That one association admits that it was at fault.
That the two associations have stopped speaking to each other.

feedback.es: Lamentar, conversaciones francas y seguir comprometidos sugieren un conflicto abierto con voluntad de diálogo; no hay culpa admitida ni cambios.

origin.audio: The two associations issued a shared statement. It says that they regret the misunderstanding, that discussions were frank, and that both remain committed to finding a way forward. It does not say who was at fault, and it does not promise any change in the timetable.

feedback.es: Cada fórmula esconde un mensaje directo: preocupación con exigencia, discusión dura, pesar sin culpa, voluntad sin acuerdo y escucha sin promesa.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo debe interpretarse este comunicado de la asociación?

choices.text: As a full apology that accepts the complaint made by the club.
As a firm rejection of every request that the club has made.
As a polite reply that postpones the matter without offering anything concrete.
As a promise to announce a decision within a few days.

feedback.es: Agradece, mantiene el asunto «under review» y no da fecha ni disculpa: pospone sin ofrecer nada concreto.

origin.text: The statement praises the club's constructive spirit and says that the association will keep the matter under review. It stops short of apologising and gives no date for any decision. Members who hoped for a clear answer may feel that they have been thanked rather than answered.

prompt.es: Escucha el comunicado y elige qué quiere decir «a frank exchange of views».

choices.text: That the two boards agreed to share the garden equally.
That the two boards swapped letters instead of meeting.
That the two boards chatted informally about the paths.
That the two boards argued openly and did not agree.

feedback.es: En el comunicado, frank esconde un desacuerdo abierto: por eso no hay acuerdo ni disculpa después.

origin.audio: The two associations published a shared statement on Friday after weeks of tension over the shared garden. It begins by noting with concern that the paths have not been cleaned. It goes on to say that the two boards held a frank exchange of views, and that both remain committed to a solution. Finally, it regrets that the meeting ended early, without saying who left first. Residents who read between the lines will notice what is missing: there is no apology, no date for the next meeting, and no mention of the rent that started the argument.

prompt.es: Escucha de nuevo: ¿qué sugiere la ausencia de disculpa y de fecha?

choices.text: That the dispute is unresolved and neither side has moved.
That the dispute is over and needs no further comment.
That the residents will organise the next meeting themselves.
That the rent is now the only issue left to resolve.

feedback.es: Sin disculpa ni fecha, leer entre líneas indica que el conflicto sigue abierto y que ninguna parte ha cedido.

origin.audio: The two associations published a shared statement on Friday after weeks of tension over the shared garden. It begins by noting with concern that the paths have not been cleaned. It goes on to say that the two boards held a frank exchange of views, and that both remain committed to a solution. Finally, it regrets that the meeting ended early, without saying who left first. Residents who read between the lines will notice what is missing: there is no apology, no date for the next meeting, and no mention of the rent that started the argument.

prompt.es: Completa: «La junta tomará nota de su queja, lo que no significa que actúe.»

feedback.es: Take note of es la fórmula de escucha sin compromiso; make note of también se usa.

origin.text: The board will ___ note of your complaint, but that does not mean that it will act on it, or even that it agrees with it.

prompt.es: Traduce a lenguaje directo: «We note with concern that the rent has not been paid.»

answer.text: We are worried that nobody has paid the rent, and we want it paid soon.
accepted: We are worried that nobody has paid the rent, and we want it paid soon.
We are concerned that the rent has not been paid, and we expect you to pay it soon.

feedback.es: La traducción directa convierte la fórmula neutra en preocupación y exigencia: estamos preocupados y queremos que se pague.

origin.text: We note with concern that the rent has not been paid.

evidenceGroups: the rent has not been paid

prompt.es: ¿Qué mensaje real transmite la junta en esta carta?

choices.text: That it accepts the complaint and will change the rules before the summer.
That it will not change the arrangements for now and will say no more.
That it shares the residents' concerns and wants to act on them quickly.
That it will meet the association soon to negotiate a new agreement.

feedback.es: Agradece y «keeps under review», pero recuerda que lo pactado se acordó de buena fe y no comentará más: no cambiará nada por ahora.

origin.text: Dear Residents' Association, we have read your letter with interest and we take note of your concerns. Our board will keep the matter under review and remains committed to open dialogue. We would, however, remind you that the current arrangements were agreed in good faith, and we are not in a position to comment further at this stage.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Preguntaron si seguimos comprometidos con el plan.»

answer.text: They asked whether we remain committed to the plan

feedback.es: En la pregunta reportada, whether + sujeto + verbo mantiene el orden afirmativo.

prompt.es: Completa: «Dijeron solo que lamentan el malentendido.»

feedback.es: Regret expresa pesar sin reconocer culpa, justo lo que hace un comunicado prudente.

origin.text: Officials declined to say who was at fault. They said only that they ___ the misunderstanding and hoped that talks could continue.
